project._comment: PROJECT SPEC (P1 engine/project separation) - board-specific knowledge that previously lived as engine constants. The engine is mechanism; this file is policy. See docs/AI_PLATFORM_ROADMAP.md.

silk_labels._comment: Ref-keyed silk FUNCTION labels (interior headers + switches) - PROJECT data because per-sheet refs collide across projects. DIP legends list words in silkscreen-position order 1..N, VERIFIED against the owning subsystem's position map (bringup_rails SW1/SW2/SW6, debug_boot boot-DIP) - a wrong legend is worse than none (LAW 0). The SoM DF40 mezzanines are intentionally absent: the 'Zynq SoM' body-silk labels that region.
